plan: Given my private value of $34, I aim to maximize profit by winning the auction but paying less than my value. Since the third-highest bid determines the payment, I should bid slightly above a mid-range value to balance winning chances and profit. A bid around $25 should be competitive enough to win while ensuring a profit margin if I win.

Given my private value of $28, I aim to maximize profit by winning the auction at a price lower than my value. To win, I should bid slightly above the average expected bid, which would be around $24.5 (halfway between $0 and $49). I will bid $25 to increase my chances of winning while keeping the bid below my value, ensuring potential profit.

Given my value of $14, I aim to bid strategically to win only if the third-highest bid is significantly lower than my value, ensuring profit. I will bid slightly above the midpoint of $7 (half of my value) to increase my probability of winning while minimizing the risk of overpaying. This approach balances the chance of winning with profit maximization.
